title: Li Auto
summary: Range-extended family SUVs with in-house autonomous driving software.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Li Auto built its position on extended-range electric vehicles, which carry a petrol generator to remove charging anxiety for large family cars. It has invested in in-house autonomous driving stacks and a charging network, and its margins depend on strong option take-up rather than the base vehicle. The strategy works while Chinese buyers prize range and space over charging speed.

Technology Exposure

  • EREV powertrains and family vehicle platforms.
  • In-house AD software and ADAS features.

What To Watch

  • Margin per vehicle as competition intensifies.
  • Take-up of paid AD features.

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 18 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.

businessMeaning: The range-extender is a transitional architecture; its commercial logic depends on charging density in the buyer's city.
investmentLens: A well-run niche manufacturer, but the EREV advantage erodes as fast-charging networks spread.
